title: Playing trumpet with a C-trombone orchestra by holding down the third valve
summary: At a country dance his brothers' E-flat clarinets did not match the local band, so he transposed by keeping a valve held down.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Cornet or trumpet: choosing and owning horns
